summary: Huntingdon County, PA tree tower built 1917 and registered with FFLOS in 2008; no longer standing, and no source describes what remains at the site.

facts.status_note: FFLOS says it is no longer standing; no removal date or site description found

events.note: Registered September 16, 2008; nominated by Henry Isenberg

evidence.supports: built in 1917 as a tree tower; no longer standing
evidence.quote: This tree tower was built in 1917 and is no longer standing.

evidence.supports: the FFLOS record gives no coordinates
campsite listing places it in Jackson Township, Huntingdon County
evidence.quote: is a campsite in Jackson Township
situated nearby to the mountain saddle Hubler Gap

evidence.supports: a birding hotspot is named for Rothrock SF Owl Gap and Sand Knob trails

corrections.why: The FFLOS record describes the structure as a tree tower built in 1917

notes_for_editor: Core facts rest on one source (FFLOS, which has no Forest Lookouts entry for Sand Knob in the PA R-Z page read). The brief's coordinates 40.7138, -77.83823 are not on the FFLOS record (it says none are available) and no source read supports them; verify before use. Mapcarta places the Sand Knob peak near Hubler Gap but gives no coordinates for the tower. Nothing found on removal date or site condition. Story is short because the evidence is thin.
